funding.raw: A critical regression in the core disaster countdown calculator is causing 100% of incoming crop loss intimations to immediately flag as expired upon submission. Simultaneously, localized calamity classification throws unhandled runtime TypeErrors when accessing non-English dictionary entries.

admission.agent_reason: Unpriced OWNER-authored incident: repo owner Manthan-cpp reports a SEV-1 production regression in which every crop-loss intimation is immediately flagged expired. The report names the target subsystem src/lib/fasal/calculator.ts, whose product code shows the inverted deadline math, so the fix scope is concrete and bounded.
